movie.title: Paper Tiger
movie.overview: Two brothers become entangled in a scheme that turns out to be too good to be true. As they try to navigate their way through the dangerous world of the Russian mafia, family bonds begin to fray with life-altering consequences.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: When two brothers get tangled in a fraudulent scheme involving the Russian mafia, their desperate bid to survive tests their loyalty with catastrophic results.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: Brothers drawn into a lucrative-sounding scheme quickly realize they are in over their heads when the Russian mafia gets involved. As the danger escalates, mistrust builds between the siblings, threatening to tear their family apart. Forced to navigate a lethal underground world, they must make impossible choices where survival comes at a devastating personal cost.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Driven by ambition and financial desperation, two brothers plunge headfirst into what appears to be a bulletproof opportunity. However, the proposal rapidly reveals itself as a high-stakes trap orchestrated by ruthless Russian mobsters. As the pressure builds and the threat of violence draws closer, the brothers struggle to maintain control over a situation rapidly spinning out of hand. Secret motives and mounting paranoia begin to erode the deep familial trust they once relied on. Trapped between criminal enforcers and their own growing resentment, every move they make triggers heavier consequences. The brothers find themselves forced into moral compromises that shatter their bond beyond repair. Ultimately, their journey through the underworld forces a final confrontation where loyalty becomes a luxury neither can afford. The fallout leaves life-altering scars, proving that the real threat was not just the enemies outside, but the fracture within.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Paper Tiger follows two brothers whose search for a way out of their financial troubles leads them straight into a deceptive scheme with the Russian mafia. What begins as a seemingly easy windfall soon devolves into a dangerous game of survival within the criminal underworld. As the external dangers grow more intense, internal rift deepens between the siblings, testing their bonds of trust, loyalty, and family. The narrative explores how ambition, greed, and fear can corrode the closest relationships when the stakes become life or death.

story_structure.climax: A critical confrontation with the mob exposes true motives and forces a high-stakes decision where survival depends on a perilous risk.
story_structure.conflict: The brothers enter into a scheme that quickly unravels, forcing them into the perilous orbit of the Russian mafia as they realize they are out of their depth.
story_structure.resolution: In the aftermath of the ordeal, the brothers must face the irreversible toll on their family relationship and adapt to their transformed lives.
story_structure.introduction: Two brothers navigate their everyday lives and deep-seated family dynamics until an alluring opportunity promises a way to significantly elevate their fortunes.
story_structure.risingAction: As high-stakes threats escalate and legal and lethal dangers close in, tensions flare between the brothers, testing their trust and eroding their bond.

characters.name: Hester Pearl
